# P1-MCP-01 frozen acceptance-case suite

`suite-freeze.json` is the frozen acceptance contract for the read-only
knowledge-mcp broker over the signed lane. It pins every
fixture under `fixtures/` by exact SHA-256 and byte size, freezes the ten case
classes named by the execution backlog (success, stale, one-lane timeout,
tamper, conflict, ACL, deletion, pagination, reconnect, deterministic-order),
and declares the exact normalization contract (volatile fields plus workspace
token) that makes case transcripts byte-reproducible across runs and machines.

The runner is `../../cmd/mcp01-acceptance`. It re-verifies every fixture pin
before each case, so one mutated fixture byte fails the whole suite closed;
`fixtures/lane-child.sh` is additionally pinned at runtime as the broker's
`--retrieval-executable`, so its bytes are load-bearing (shfmt-canonical —
a reformat requires re-pinning the freeze).

Hermetic run against a locally built broker (exercises the live stdio JSON-RPC
protocol plus the authenticated Streamable HTTP transport on loopback):

```bash
go -C tools/knowledge-mcp build -trimpath -o /tmp/archeion-knowledge-mcp .
go -C tools/knowledge-mcp build -trimpath -o /tmp/mcp01-acceptance ./cmd/mcp01-acceptance
/tmp/mcp01-acceptance \
  --suite tools/knowledge-mcp/testdata/mcp01-acceptance \
  --broker /tmp/archeion-knowledge-mcp \
  --out /tmp/mcp01-transcripts
```

Later in-cluster acceptance execution targets the live broker with
`--endpoint https://…/mcp --token-file <mounted-or-local token>` instead of
`--broker`; cases requiring fixture control report `not_executable_on_live`,
and a typed fail-closed live lane reports `blocked`, never `pass`.

`fixtures/registry/candidate-manifest.json` is generated byte-identically by
`TestWriteMCP01AcceptanceRegistryFixture` (see `../../mcp01_fixture_gen_test.go`);
`TestMCP01AcceptanceRegistryFixtureIsFrozen` fails when the fixture and its
generator drift. The remaining fixtures are hand-frozen JSON mirroring the
broker's own signed-current response and admission-policy schemas.
